state.question: Has Juneway Shipping's operating change resolved the question about container schedule reliability? Focus on: September calls arriving within one day of schedule compared with August, using port-call counts.
state.conclusion: Juneway added a vessel to its coastal loop.
state.gap: September calls arriving within one day of schedule compared with August, using port-call counts.

candidates.title: Juneway Shipping: the measurement desk
candidates.abstract: I set out the case for Juneway Shipping's strategy in container schedule reliability, using incentives and managerial judgement to project the next stage.

candidates.abstract: An operating note about Juneway Shipping: The loop now operates five vessels.

candidates.abstract: An edited digest of Luca Ames's Dispatch's dispatch on Juneway Shipping, retaining its reported comparison and attribution.

candidates.title: Juneway Shipping: the strategic argument
candidates.abstract: Juneway port-call register supports a dated assessment of september calls arriving within one day of schedule compared with August, using port-call counts.

candidates.title: Juneway Shipping: the operating record
candidates.abstract: Our reporting desk follows Juneway Shipping, drawing on an independent correspondent's account of september calls arriving within one day of schedule compared with August, using port-call counts.

candidates.title: Juneway Shipping: the weekly notebook
candidates.abstract: A commentary revisiting Juneway Shipping's operating announcement, carrying the same factual account as the public record.
